title: Talyana Shares A New Singel "Crystal Clear"
htmlContent:
Commanding fantastic melodies, young singer Talyana envelops us in her rhythmic magic on her latest single, "Crystal Clear."

With a beautiful blend of R&B and soul, this phenomenal artist transits her voice through a smooth, pleasant instrumental that provides an excellent structure so that her vocal harmonies can shine and show all her talent and strong personality.

Stream "Crystal Clear" on Spotify
